purpose: Route veterans to legal resources. Covers discharge upgrades (DRB, BCMR/BCNR), VA benefits appeals (Supplemental Claim, HLR, BVA, CAVC), Military Sexual Trauma legal support, civilian legal aid (housing, employment, family, consumer, criminal record), military records correction, and predatory lending / scam VSO reporting.
design_note: Legal issues never block. Every veteran receives a path regardless of discharge status or situation.
